provenance: Compiled from 59 public @noahperlofit Instagram reels. Macros, costs and serving counts are the creator's stated claims, not lab-verified. Prices in USD. null = not stated by the creator.

meals.name: McDonald's-Style Breakfast Sandwiches
key_ingredients: 1 kg ground turkey + 1 kg ground beef
meals.method: Mix meats with seasonings and syrup, form and cook patties. Assemble muffins with sauce, avocado, patty, cheese, egg, apple.

meals.name: Breakfast Sandwich Batch
key_ingredients: High-protein breakfast sandwich build (eggs, lean meat, cheese, light bread/muffin)
meals.method: Batch-cook components, assemble sandwiches, portion for the week.

meals.name: Breakfast Burritos

meals.method: Cook fillings, assemble burritos, wrap and freeze.

meals.name: Breakfast Sandwiches x16
key_ingredients: High-protein breakfast sandwich build for 16 (eggs, lean meat, cheese, light bread)

meals.name: 8-Minute Breakfast Sandwich

meals.name: Fluffy Protein Pancakes
key_ingredients: Protein pancake batter (protein powder/flour, egg/egg whites)
meals.method: Mix batter, cook fluffy pancakes, portion for the week.

meals.name: High-Protein French Toast
meals.method: Soak sliced brioche in egg-white custard; pan-fry golden. Finish with chocolate, sugar, syrup.

meals.name: Chimichurri Steak Subs

meals.name: Chicken Gyros

meals.name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Pockets
meals.method: Bake ranch-seasoned chicken; cook diced turkey bacon. Fill tortillas (quarter removed), fold and grill.

meals.name: Chicken Pesto Panini
meals.method: Batch-cook pesto chicken, assemble grilled panini sandwiches, wrap in foil.

meals.name: Cuban-Style Sandwich
key_ingredients: Low-calorie high-protein Cuban-style sandwich build (pork/chicken, ham, pickles, mustard, Swiss-style cheese, pressed bread)
meals.method: Layer Cuban-style fillings, press/grill, portion for the week.

meals.name: Cowboy Butter Chicken Sandwiches
meals.method: Bake seasoned chicken. Mix herb butter. Assemble hollowed baguettes with butter, chicken, provolone, hot honey.

meals.name: Buffalo Chicken Panini
meals.method: Cook buffalo-seasoned chicken. Fill hollowed baguettes with ranch, chicken, provolone; press.

meals.name: Meatball Subs
meals.method: Batch-cook meatballs, assemble subs with sauce and cheese, wrap in foil.

meals.name: Korean Fried Chicken Sandwiches
meals.method: Bread and cook chicken thighs, sauce them, assemble sandwiches, wrap in foil.

meals.name: Steak Naan Sandwich (Greek-Yogurt Naan)

meals.name: Shawarma Steak Wrap (Homemade Pita)

meals.name: Marinated Steak Sandwiches (Open-Faced)

meals.name: Honey Mustard Chicken Sandwiches
meals.method: Bread chicken (flour, egg, cornflakes) and bake instead of frying. Assemble with honey mustard.

meals.name: Thick Bacon Cheeseburgers (ChatGPT Episode)

meals.name: Chicken Shawarma

meals.name: Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches

hot sauce (Frank's RedHot, brown sugar substitute, honey, butter)

meals.name: Honey BBQ Chicken Sliders

meals.name: Low-Calorie Chicken Gyro
meals.method: Sear spiced chicken; assemble gyro with sauce and veggies.

meals.name: Cheeseburger Sliders

meals.name: Buffalo Chicken Ranch Sandwiches
meals.method: Cook buffalo-seasoned chicken. Fill hollowed baguettes with ranch, chicken, provolone.

meals.name: Thick Bacon Sliders
meals.method: Bake sheet-pan beef patty; make sweet-heat bacon jam. Assemble slab sliders with mayo, patty, cheese, jam.

meals.name: Thick Bacon Sliders (What's the Catch?)

meals.name: Steak & Cheese Burritos

meals.name: Chicken & Cheese Tacos (What's the Catch?)

meals.name: Nashville Hot Chicken Cutlet Crunchwraps
meals.method: Pound, bread and bake chicken cutlets; brush with hot sauce. Assemble wraps with cabbage, pickles, cheese; griddle folded.

meals.name: Steak Burritos with Cilantro-Lime Rice & Street-Corn Salsa
meals.method: Grill seasoned steak, dice. Make cilantro-lime rice and corn salsa. Assemble burritos.

meals.name: Chipotle Chicken Burritos
meals.method: Bake chipotle-seasoned chicken, chop. Assemble burritos with rice, beans, corn, chicken, cheese; toast.

meals.name: Crunchwraps

meals.name: Birria Tacos

meals.name: Rosemary-Butter Steak & Crispy Yukon Gold Potatoes

meals.name: Better Taquito Sunday
